description: This PHP source file defines the S3TablesClient class, which is used to interact with the Amazon S3 Tables service within the AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for operations such as create, delete, retrieve, and list tables and namespaces, as well as configuration methods related to table management.

classes.name: S3TablesClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, specialized for interacting with the Amazon S3 Tables service, providing various methods (annotated) for table and namespace management.

methods.name: createNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new namespace in the S3 Tables service.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table within a namespace.
